direct_claims: This chart shows estimated annual malaria deaths by world region over time.
The subject is global malaria mortality, broken down by region.
It covers all ages and both sexes.
The source is IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025), and it is presented by Our World in Data.
The chart presents estimates rather than a direct count, indicating the numbers come from modeled disease-burden assessment rather than a complete census of every malaria death.
Because the figure is stacked by region, it supports both reading the global total and comparing each region's contribution to that total.
Exact year-by-year regional values cannot be read confidently from the image alone.
The chart does not, by itself, explain why mortality changed over time, so causal interpretation requires outside evidence.
